scope: Health and emergency-service facts for Puerto Williams verified against Chilean institutional sources

facts.claim: The Hospital Comunitario Cristina Calderón operates in Puerto Williams and is part of the Servicio de Salud Magallanes network.
The establishment remains registered as an accredited institutional health provider; Superintendencia de Salud records its second accreditation in 2024.
A June 2026 public procurement process identifies the hospital at O'Higgins 246, Puerto Williams, and concerns updating and normalizing critical hospital systems.
facts.publisher: Mercado Público / Hospital Comunitario Cristina Calderón

facts.claim: The hospital was actively delivering territorial health services in 2026; MINSAL reported a hospital team conducting a health operation in Caleta Douglas in February 2026.
Specialty-care rounds were carried out in Puerto Williams in May 2026 through coordination between Servicio de Salud Magallanes and Fundación ACRUX.
facts.scope_note: This demonstrates periodic specialty outreach, not permanent on-site availability of every specialty.

not_yet_canonical.reason: No sufficiently current Chilean institutional source was located in this verification pass to state exact current hours or 24/7 coverage.
Older official sources document ambulance and emergency equipment, but were not treated as current 2026 capacity.
Temporary specialty rounds do not prove permanent staffing.
Emergency phone numbers and service routing should be fetched from current official sources at answer time rather than embedded as static facts.
Carabineros, Armada/DIRECTEMAR and Bomberos are known local institutions, but their current operational contact details and incident-response scope need a dedicated primary-source verification pass.

retrieval_policy.stable_questions: May use the canonical hospital identity and network relationship.
retrieval_policy.current_medical_service_questions: Require current Servicio de Salud Magallanes or MINSAL verification.
retrieval_policy.emergency_now_questions: Do not answer from the static RAG alone; route to live official information.
retrieval_policy.specialty_availability_questions: Treat as dynamic unless a current official schedule explicitly confirms availability.
